chunks: None of the signs of their Lord ever comes to them but they turn away from it.
ai.seo_question: Why do people turn away from the signs of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yaseen underscores the psychological state of *istikbar* (arrogance) that blinds the disbelievers to the *ayat* (signs) of their Lord, whether in nature or revelation. It illustrates how persistent rejection leads to a hardened heart, a theme central to the narrative of the Prophet Muhammad's struggle with the Quraysh. This specific description of turning away serves as a precursor to the detailed account of the three messengers sent to the people of Yaseen.
